back: Independent: changed. Dependent: measured. Control: kept the same.

front: How is a table column headed?
back: quantity / unit, e.g. length / m; units are not repeated in the table.
Independent variable on x; labelled axes with units; sensible scales filling the grid; neat points; one best-fit line.
Δy ÷ Δx, using a large triangle on the best-fit line.
Random: scatter, reduced by repeating. Systematic: shift every reading the same way (e.g. zero error), fixed by correcting the method.

front: What to do with an anomalous result?
back: Identify it, check by repeating, and leave it out of the mean if it is a mistake.
Metre rule 1 mm; vernier calipers 0.1 mm; micrometer 0.01 mm.
